description: This is a test source file for the ContactsHandler class in an Android application. It contains unit tests verifying permission handling, contact search, and contact addition functionalities, using JUnit and mocking of data sources.

classes.name: ContactsHandlerTest
classes.description: A unit test class for testing the ContactsHandler functionalities in an Android environment, including permission checks and contact management.

classes.name: FakeContactsDataSource
classes.description: A mock implementation of ContactsDataSource for testing, simulating permission responses, search results, and contact addition.

classes.name: ContactRecord
classes.description: A data class representing contact information, including identifiers, names, organization, phone numbers, and emails.
